notes.title: Custom World Contest 2025 - Results
notes.notes:
The theme of the contest was punk.
The creators were allowed to interept that however they wanted.
Here are all the custom worlds that was contributed.

We have contacted all creators for details so they can recieve their pin.

[h2][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3488577835&searchtext=]Neon Alleys - 722 722[/url][/h2]
[h3]Creator: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241035/6f5a70936a53926ad7ae63878c212adc1a841e0b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241035/64862b4124b861385afc49cd1980709800b37c6d.jpg[/img]
A super creative world with a lot of funny surprises.
Being able to defeat and enemy by waiting for the entire song or defeating them made the experience feel really alive.
Themewise and execution of the theme punk was great!

Thank you Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2 (lol) for this amazing experience!

[h2][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3464169211&searchtext=]Omega Incinerator - 242 111[/url][/h2]
[h3]Creator:ANIMA[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241035/cdb19cc1b5651d87d821f5db3988513fdce8b7a6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241035/8e3dd09a4e5b97e30efa6a44d4fe492bc6b0dfa7.jpg[/img]
Technically very impressive and visually absolutely mesmerizing!
The difficulty is quite hard but it is worth grinding to see the madness unfold.

It was certianly not something we expected could be possible but very happy that this experience is now available for everyone, Thank you ANIMA!

[h2][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3490485186&searchtext=]Dead Signal Spire - 116 411[/url][/h2]
[h3]Creator: Altin and Akairuma[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241035/83293b45a752fce9cfbddcf80f0187b620a6709a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241035/4032cacbffea3bd6c9e6688391c7c50463333192.jpg[/img]
Lots of great character personality with expressive portraits and funny cutscenes and
environment artwork that is detailed and exciting to explore.

A fun and lovely experience!

[h2][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3487861802&searchtext=]Steampunk Tournament - 159 311[/url][/h2]
[h3]Creators: RoberPro, Scarlet and ANIMA[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241035/6cd849be6b6d1fb58812fc91cd05837508cbdfea.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241035/7f947d6c4a8a77906f83e99218c1b7f8d0f4d938.png[/img]
This custom world is still not finished but it boasts three great battles with unique personalities!
Each battle has their own flair typical Everhood style and it keept me on my toes, I died a surprisingly amount of times against the first enemy but the jams were good.

I hope to see more of this world, thank you RoberPro for creating this!

[h2][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3481806692&searchtext=]Nightclub Hoi - 190713[/url][/h2]
[h3]Creators: Maria_MiraclE[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241035/f2f04c1170c3b24fa90a4c94449c1f83334ea15f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241035/90a5adf0a2da8b78a72870286255c99ee0fac7a3.jpg[/img]
It starts off with a great introduction and then into a melancholic song and show.
I usually don't get teary eyed but I couldn't help myself with this one.

Fantastic work Maria_MiraclE!

[h2][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3491025317&searchtext=]Clockwork Cathedral - 133 667[/url][/h2]
[h3]Creator: ToMo[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241035/a5e5caaac18bced5103d3226f05f3e13803a5446.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241035/331f9281657b28424a2c9e7fbfef8a2e95c7c2a8.png[/img]
This custom world is not finished yet but it has managed to capture a fantastic atmosphere and intriguing setting. I want to see more of this world!

[h2][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3491031830&searchtext=]Beat Down In Boiler City - 211 994[/url][/h2]
[h3]Creator: HAL9000[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241035/f7172e8c74256707362ae86d30afb6f40ba74b74.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241035/295f79f228336d14039fb73335e361b5a30851ea.jpg[/img]
An insane well crafted reimagination of ANTONBLAST!
The artistic style is fantastic done and many surprising amount of gimmicks not seen before that feel right in the essence of ANTONBLAST!

Great to see you contributing another awesome battle HAL9000!

[h2][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3491082887&searchtext=]Castle Gargoyle - 096 262[/url][/h2]
[h3]Creator: bongoguy[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241035/8e710904c0e2cb35d863889b78398a8e40703a1a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241035/c3665e202f3715a0f6ad7319b7b346652264a20a.png[/img]
This custom world is unfinished but it was fun to explore an escher maze and finding new unique mushrooms designs!


[h2][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3490580869&searchtext=]Fallen Light Being - 072 550[/url][/h2]
[h3]Creator: MushroomManToad[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241035/0250611c2ff2d7b81427d762382887a9a05fb344.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241035/15669920438772cc5fcb6944b3299957421b5d87.jpg[/img]
This is the last submission of the contest and it ends with a banger.
A great build and intriguing dialogue that connects main game with this room and leading up to this contest's hardest battle.

I've tried 15 times and I still haven't "properly" able to beat the battle as of right now but I will give it another 10 tries.

Well so far my best is 1168 hp left so I never get to see the ending but I've had a blast playing it!
Recommending if you want a true challenge!



Thank you all the creators for creating these wonderful levels and populating the Hillbert Hotel!
Let us know in our discord if you need any assistance, we are always there to help out!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241035/dda8d33acfd6e356106e48a2a4ae98a21c24e30f.jpg[/img]
[h2]
CUSTOM WORLD CONTEST[/h2]
Starts now!
Contest ends at 31st May 9PM CET.
[i](2 months development time)[/i]

15 creators will win a Rasta Beast Pin!
[i]We want to give out some sort of reward because it is cool! [/i]

[b]The theme of the contest is PUNK.[/b]
[list]
[*] Maybe the enemy encounter is a just a punk?
[*] Maybe the music is rock or the environment has a punk-rock-vibe?
[*] or maybe room is steampunk?
[/list]

We will highlight the best custom worlds in a post!

[b]Categories[/b]
Best custom world, best theme interpiration and best battle.
[i](might be more sub-categories depending on amount of custom worlds.)[/i]

[b]How to make Custom Worlds?[/b]
Open EVERHOOD 2 and select Custom Worlds for more information.

[b]Rules[/b]
- The custom world must be submitted in steam workshop and tagged #customworldcontest2025
- You can submit any amount of Custom Worlds.
- You can only win one pin.
- Custom worlds published before 28th MARCH do not qualify for the contest.

Join our discord to get help or advice!

[b]Custom Worlds[/b] - Hot Reload your mod.
How to Use:
[olist]
[*] Go inside your Everhood 2 folder Steam\steamapps\common\Everhood2
[*] Insert your mod file .infinity in TestMod.
[*] Open up Everhood 2 and once inside main menu press F6 and it will load your custom world.
[/olist]
You can also press F6 to reload the custom world while inside the custom world.
This allows you to make changes in the editor, make a buiild and then press F6 inside EVERHOOD 2 and the changes will update.
